intrinsics.name: _mm512_cvt_roundepi32_ps
intrinsics.description:
Convert packed signed 32-bit integers in "a" to packed single-precision (32-bit) floating-point elements, and store the results in "dst".
	[round_note]
intrinsics.operation:
FOR j := 0 to 15
	i := 32*j
	dst[i+31:i] := Convert_Int32_To_FP32(a[i+31:i])
ENDFOR
dst[MAX:512] := 0

intrinsics.name: _mm512_sqrt_round_ps
intrinsics.description:
Compute the square root of packed single-precision (32-bit) floating-point elements in "a", and store the results in "dst".
	[round_note].
intrinsics.operation:
FOR j := 0 to 15
	i := j*32
	dst[i+31:i] := SQRT(a[i+31:i])
ENDFOR
dst[MAX:512] := 0

intrinsics.name: _mm512_add_round_ps
intrinsics.description:
Add packed single-precision (32-bit) floating-point elements in "a" and "b", and store the results in "dst".
	[round_note]
intrinsics.operation:
FOR j := 0 to 15
	i := j*32
	dst[i+31:i] := a[i+31:i] + b[i+31:i]
ENDFOR
dst[MAX:512] := 0

intrinsics.name: _mm512_mul_round_ps
intrinsics.description:
Multiply packed single-precision (32-bit) floating-point elements in "a" and "b", and store the results in "dst". 
	[round_note]
intrinsics.operation:
FOR j := 0 to 15
	i := j*32
	dst[i+31:i] := a[i+31:i] * b[i+31:i]
ENDFOR
dst[MAX:512] := 0

intrinsics.name: _mm512_sub_round_ps
intrinsics.description:
Subtract packed single-precision (32-bit) floating-point elements in "b" from packed single-precision (32-bit) floating-point elements in "a", and store the results in "dst".
	[round_note]
intrinsics.operation:
FOR j := 0 to 15
	i := j*32
	dst[i+31:i] := a[i+31:i] - b[i+31:i]
ENDFOR
dst[MAX:512] := 0
